name: Higinio Hernández-Delgado
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near State and Monroe
description:
Higinio Hernández-Delgado is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 45, scars map her face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on s — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Her entry into running was involuntary — a debt to the wrong people, a choice between working it off or losing parts — and the debt is still not fully paid. She works as a fixer out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Higinio Hernández-Delgado is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Ximena Engstrom-Fofana on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A crew member from Ximena Engstrom-Fofana's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Ximena Engstrom-Fofana is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: As a fixer, Ximena Engstrom-Fofana embodies the tension between independence and isolation. She is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Independent — maintains network of professional contacts

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Complex global ancestry: 41% Hispanic/Latin American, 23% Sub-Saharan African, 21% East Asian, 15% South Asian. This rare quaternary blend manifests in warm medium-brown skin with golden undertones, bone structure combining East Asian cheekbones with broader African and South Asian nasal bridge, fuller lips, and slightly wider face. The genetic mosaic creates a distinctly multicultural appearance — neither regionally locked nor easily categorized.
physical_description.build: Lean and long-limbed with developed musculature from years of field work. Synthetic muscle fiber in legs adds subtle bulk to calves and thighs — visible as a slight chromatic sheen under skin. Moves with economical, practiced precision.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper gray, naturally dark with silver threading
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid. Minimal styling — practicality over aesthetics.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with faint augmentation scarring at the orbital corners
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones, sun-weathered from decades of variable outdoor work. The blended ancestry creates subtle depth — warm East Asian-Latin golden tones enriched by Sub-Saharan richness and South Asian complexion, creating a balanced fusion rather than stark contrast.
physical_description.complexion: Mapped with old scar tissue — three thin parallel lines across left cheekbone, puckered burn scar along right temple hairline, white knife-wound scar bisecting upper lip. Minimal makeup. Skin shows texture and history; grooming is clean but not refined. Facial structure reflects the multicultural ancestry: East Asian eye shape and upper face definition, broader nasal bridge from African heritage, fuller lips and slightly wider face from South Asian and African genetics, creating a cosmopolitan blend.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel scars across left cheekbone, approximately 8cm total length, surgical-clean edges suggesting deliberate marking rather than accidental injury
Puckered thermal burn scar along right temple, fading to pale pink, approximately 4cm diameter
White knife scar bisecting upper lip vertically, thin but prominent, approximately 3cm length
Chrome-visible synthetic muscle fiber replacement visible along both shins — metallic shimmer beneath skin at calf, particularly visible under bright light
Faint augmentation scarring at orbital corners where early optic work was considered but not pursued
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Synthetic muscle fiber replacement visible in legs as subtle chromatic shimmer under skin, especially calves and thighs — noticeable when moving quickly or wearing form-fitting clothing. Gecko-grip fingertip implants visible as faint metallic stippling on fingertips and toe pads when hands/feet are examined closely. No obvious chrome plating or obvious neural ports.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with shoulders relaxed but spine straight. Moves with deliberate economy — every motion purposeful, no wasted energy. Favors stairs with caution due to synthetic leg limitations but compensates with handrail usage. Climbs with unusual fluidity thanks to gecko-grip implants. Resting expression is neutral to slightly weary; maintains eye contact during negotiations.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear. Standard: fitted dark synthweave pants with cargo pockets, reinforced synthetic leather jacket (usually charcoal or black, worn but maintained), layered base clothes in neutral tones. Footwear is always climbing-friendly (grippy soles). Jewelry minimal — watch with encrypted display (professional tool, not fashion), no other visible adornment. Clothing shows wear and repair but is clean and intentional. No corp branding. Dressed for function and mobility, not status.
